title: Inverse image of a torsion etale sheaf is torsion
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $F\in\Ab(V_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] be a torsion abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf]. Then its inverse image $u^{-1}F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is a torsion abelian sheaf.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section label section-torsion, Tag 0DDB (torsion sheaves), with Lemma label lemma-stalk-pullback, Tag 03Q1 ($(u^{-1}F)_{\bar x}=F_{u(\bar x)}$): the stalks of $u^{-1}F$ are stalks of $F$, hence torsion; equivalently $u^{-1}$ is exact and commutes with colimits, so $u^{-1}(F[n])=(u^{-1}F)[n]$ and $u^{-1}\varinjlim_nF[n]=\varinjlim_n u^{-1}F[n]$. Stacks states no separate lemma; the place is where the fact is used without comment
